[PART III.]  Transitional Authority

 

     [§454F-51]  Purpose.  The purpose of this part is to implement section 106 of the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act, P.L. 115-174. [L 2019, c 74, pt of §1]
